stem: In May 2026 new businesses added €3,000 of Business Care MRR, upgrades added €400 and cancellations removed €1,000. Which MRR goes into the denominator of Voltmarkt's CAC payback for May?

options.text: The €2,400 of net new MRR, after upgrades and cancellations
The €3,400 of new and upgrade MRR together
Business Care's whole MRR at the end of May
